en: When both houses of Congress approve a bill and the President signs it, the proposed legislation officially becomes a binding Philippine law.
By carving step-like terraces into the steep Cordillera mountains, the Ifugao people created flat land to successfully cultivate rice.
Jose Rizal wrote Noli Me Tangere to expose Spanish friar abuses, which awakened Filipino nationalism and inspired the revolution.
Devotees perform the rhythmic Sinulog dance to the beat of drums, which physically demonstrates their deep reverence for the Santo Niño.
Doctor Fe del Mundo designed a bamboo incubator where hot water in the outer jacket radiates heat to keep newborns warm without electricity.
If the President issues an executive order, the Supreme Court can review it and declare the action unconstitutional if it violates the Constitution.
By reading the Act of the Declaration of Independence, Emilio Aguinaldo officially announced the Philippines' freedom from Spanish colonial rule.
In the Bayanihan tradition, an entire community physically lifts and carries a traditional nipa hut to relocate a family to a new site.
Ancient Filipinos used pointed sticks to carve curved characters onto bamboo tubes, which allowed them to record messages using the Baybayin script.
Farmers use the carabao to pull heavy wooden plows through muddy fields, which efficiently tills the soil for planting rice.
When eligible citizens cast their ballots during elections, they exercise their right to choose the leaders who will govern them.
By encoding his personal grief and social commentary into an epic poem, Francisco Balagtas used Florante at Laura to secretly criticize corrupt Spanish officials.
